cohort: Ninety preterm neonates were divided into three groups (Gentle Human Touch, Yakson, and control) with interventions starting 7 days after birth.
finding: Gentle Human Touch and Yakson methods enhanced physiological parameters and improved the sleep state for preterm neonates compared to routine care, with Yakson showing statistically significant higher sleep state and behavioral reaction than GHT.
mod_finding: No statistically significant difference was found between the groups in relation to mode of delivery.
